Archive Administrator commands

Run this command to remove NBS packages which are not required any more:

remove-package -m NBS -d ubuntu -s tenacious -b -y libcpgplot0 libgiza0 libtrilinos-nox-16.1 libtrilinos-rtop-16.1 libtrilinos-teuchos-16.1 libtrilinos-thyra-16.1 libtrilinos-tpetra-16.1 libtrilinos-trilinosss-16.1 libtrilinos-triutils-16.1
